book.name: Yonna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Yonna Yesusmoa. Yonmba Ishomnavna Yesusm, Sesoana Ombolm.

content: Yesusva Sehelm Innemba Wonnena Betanira.
Minguva mongal mendah lohvna, tihva si os ophovav, Pasovatihva. Yesusva gavna Betani kembellam, dom ten Lasarus avnam. Lasarusva noi, ten Yesus pokamarini wolaihaphonam mindil.
Wo di himba innemba waihlana Yesusmba, Martava inne leswol vevna. Lasarus hev noi innemba waihlana Yesusmba.

Maria welsanda longve, nomba diva os lohmanavna i, wo himba selvowol vevna Yesusna monglamba nona, wo poswol venavna henga hevna tana, hivhoalmba. Wo nomba teihnungva besalva deuvmorava ambo ningiwulvna.
Yutas Iskariot, mongo Yesustindirini, himba di avnata eva. Himba noi, sewonamba he si Yesusmba holvorahunvav ungundmba. Yutas ona,
honamba welsandava diva mara os lohmanavna K300. Ata eva mama dinasvom indhanam vrahunta, wo diva nomba innehuinindm moang vinvta.

Wo heva os Yutasva ambo dasalm ovna, himba keknamba ninginvnamoa innehuinindmba. Himba ishovna honamba, noinda himba hevpa yukovol lohvna. He disumbva sunguwulavna, wo himba nomini yukov velohvna diva.
Yesus ophona, aembu, hemoa ambo novangas sihavra. Himba lehra temba vev, hona welsandamba lungulamana vena khui, veiva, daipota men, kanamba nihmba kokolma vrelmba, singvelmba sewonam lehei.
Innehuinindva si elsus yemba pulningewuvmona vevra, wo heva os yimba kamba si elsusva waieuvmona vevramoa.

Indkumbiva Yutanindva ahalovna, osva ona, doa men Yesusva av Betanira, wo doa himba provna heindamba. Wo heva os himba Yesusmangasmba nonglalmba ambvnamoa. Owai, himba nonora lovahvna, una, nemetva Yesusva wolaihaphona pokamarini Lasarusmba, wo himba eva nonglalm vivnata Lasarusmba.
Wo nonawusra sembayang andranindna kuwulva moamba vivrivna, helvakomandhalmba Lasarusmba evata,
manara, Lasarusm nunglinam hevna novna, wo noinda indkumbiva Yutanindva henaminiva anginvna, Yesusmangas keknamba tovopethamnavna.
Yesusva King Kuwulmsna Sihana Yerusalemrava.
Mongnasiva indhanamba plombmsnamba diva livnamba Yerusalemba, ahalona, ona, doa ten Yesusva prov domba. Hind noi, ten prowonam Pasovatihram.
Wo himba naiti manimani noi vravnamba, nona kangawonga vruwulangavna, nonam suwihalm Yesusm monaram. Hev dandwonam opelpanganam,

content.text: Hosana, okulu Sesoam. Sesoa awothov hemba, himba memba provpa mendeklina nihillava. Sesoa awotho pina Israelnindna king kuwulmoa. Buk Song 118:25-26

content: Yesusva omnanamba, donkiva nosra gana. Doaramini Sesoana tombaimorava os novol velohv,

content.text: Ata ye pem vivav Yerusalemnind. Yenamba king kuwulva ten prunv. Himba donki bimbella ovhoana, nosra prov. Sekaraia 9:9

content: Seilmba hevtindiva tit vivna hona moana plalmba. Heva os venamba, Yesusva phonamba pokamariniva, nonamba Sesoava hevna pusambanakambara hemba desvhoana, wo himba henga ningna, osva honamba novol velohmanav hemba. Wo himba ningna nomba, osva kava doa vinina honamba hemba.
Indhanamba Monglava Eishomnavna Yesusm.

Indhanamba esvema pulundvund vevna, nonamba Yesusva deuhvhovnamba Lasarusmba mindilva, omnavnamba, pholahangalmba pokamariniva. Wo doa himba vinamba, moamba vruwul vinvna owalmba, osva ona, Yesusva os vei.
Wo indhanamba ahui vevna, nonglalmba Yesusmba, noinda himba hillivnamba nom mendekliandram.
Wo Varisinindva hevm eishovna, una, memba pimba alhuvpa honi Yesusna mendekliandrarava, ambo pimba seposa uv moalm. Manara, indhanamba pethanindva indkumbiva doa hemangas pelpethamnav.
Yesusva Ishunna Hevna Dahalmom.
Eva diva monglava Griknindva doara lovahvna, himba sembayangm ambanamba Pasovatihram Yerusalemram Yutanindmongom.
Himba anga Pilipindam, Pilippa nomba Betsaita kembellini Galili provinsrini. Hev umnina, mendekli, kava nonglalm viv Yesusm.
Pilip ishomna Endrum. Wo Pilipi Endrui ihishomnana Yesusmba.
Wo Yesusva unna, doa nambaiva phoi, arana ombolva ata hevna pusambava levraholothunvav.

Heva os kamba si boasna dahavav. Memba os, maim oi, indhanarini witkul koko vev osora. Witkulva koko veperava petharamba, braovevav. Wo kulva esvemava kethavra. Wo heva os hemba braovemba owai vellava, wo osva himba si esvemava kethavavmoa nihilva.
Himba nomba hevmangasva duus vrevrava, himba si owolakohavra. Heva himba nomba hevna undmba popeng vrelmba owai vevrava hona petharava, si himba wohlohvav yunalm.
Himba nomba kamba andra vinivrava, heoa kam engivra. Wo kana andranindva si waivivra kamba, hivemava eva kava avra. Kana ara si okolawol vevra, himba nomba kamba andra vinivrava.
Daipotava kamba doa kin yuhle. Ata eva kava es ovav? Os ata kava ovavma, ara, kamoa kolvro, kamba dahavavmoa. Owai, kava prov men honanam, os kava manapenam kinmba guavra.
Ara, yeoa pevna pusambamoa ambara levraholotho. Wo moalamang ophona senamini, kava doa venata, wo eva si henga kava vevav.
Wo indhanamba nomba di pulundvund vevnamba, nomba moalamangmba hillivna. Wo himba os uvna, hul ov. Wo heva os monglava os uvna, ovsongolnindrini hemba ishomnav.
Yesus unna, no moalamangva temba yem, kamba owai.
Daipotava memba Sesoava doa yem pethanindm lesvhoawolalm vev. Wo doa daipotava himba si wulengva piangavav pethanindna kuwulmba Setanmba.
Si boasna kamba sena wukleihivav, wo nonamba kav indkumbim si os nembaomana vevav kaindava.
Yesusva ishunvna honamba, osm ora, si os kamba dahavav kruserava.
Wo indhana noi avnam, hev umnina, kava hillina lohohmorava, os Kristusva si yunalm wohavav. Wo manara yimba oi osva, arana ombolva si dahavav? Wo an nomba arana ombolva?

Wo Yesus ophona, upsilva si yemba wonasambaihavav. Wo beswonam lohmana vevm, nonamoa upsilva lohvrava. Wo ata homeis sia yem kekaiv vevm. Himba nomba sikulmonamba lohmana vevrava, himba tit vev, osva kava henamonam gav?

Wo noinda osva yeoa keknam undnahonam lovahthamno kam, mendahva kava yemba wonavrava. Wo osva yimba si upsilna towandaslalnonoa avav. Nonamba Yesusva honamba osva ishopianamba, himba os gana, kokmondha vrevna hevmba indhanakomonam.
Yutanindva Mindnam Keknamba Undnahonamba Lovahthamnavnamoa Yesusmba.
Eva Yesusva doava mendekli andrava vinvna indhanana novrava, heva os owai, himba mendah keknamba lovahthamnavnamoa Yesusmba.
Memba honamba nom, temba Aisaiava moashulnindriniva ishonamba, himba wohengivna. Os novol velohv,

content.text: Mendekli, anmund kek vithiv honamba moamba, kava memba ishunvpa hemba? Anmund nunglina doava yena andrasowolva, wo he una, honamba phov Sesoanaminiangas? Aisaia 53:1

content: Wo mongmomba Aisaianamba eva novol velohv os,

content.text: Sesoa doa no indhanana novm ehlathowol vinvna, wo hev hena nengavnangm indkokla vrowol vinvna. Sesoava osva owai vewol vetava, wo himba beswonam novvivavta, wo beswonam ningvavta, wo kava hemba sishona vrowol vevav, heva os owai. Aisaia 6:10

content: Aisaiava ishona os, manara noinda himba doara heva nonglana Yesusna pusambakambamba, wo eva hem doara ishomnavna. Hev unna, Yutanindva owai, Yesusmba undnahonamba keknamba lovahthamnavmoa.

Wo heva os monglava keknam undnahonam lovahthamnavna Yesusmba, eva nomba Yutanindna kuwulva mindnam. Heva os Varisinindnapenamba himba osva uvnamoa, kava keknam undnahonam lovahthamnav hemba. Himba pem vivna, osra ata kamba wolapulvo vevav sembayangdiniva.
Himba undva os vivrivna, indhanaoa kamoa okolawol vivra, himba osva ningvnamoa, Sesoa kamoa okolawol vevra.
Wo Yesus dandwonam ophona, yimba himba nomba kamba undnahonamba lovahthamnavrava, yimba tanam eva undnahonam lovahthamnavrata hem, nomba temba himba kamba homba wolaihapranamba.
Wo himba nomba kamba nonglavpa, wo eva himba nomba nonglavta, temba himba nomba kamba wolaihapranamba.
Kava pusambamsna prona hona petharamba. Kava osm prona, himba nomba kamba undnahonamba lovahthamnavrava, si avavmoa sikulmonamba.
Wo himba nomba kana moamba hillivrava, wo engwol vivramoa, kava hemba nomba lesvhoawol vevramoa. Noinda kava lesvhoawolalmba prunnamoa pethanindmba, heva os lopshalm pethanindm.

Heva os lohvta, lesvhoawolalmba hem, nomba temba ningvmoa, keknamba kamba lovahthamnalmba, eva vreivmoa kana moamba. Moamba nonamba kava numhowol vevpa, temba hem lesvhoawolalm, ovi pethai hoai evewolvram.
Kava nonamba memba numhowol vevpa, kanamba kavnaminiva owai. Ara noi ten kam wolaihapranam, ishomnana kamba, osm ishunilm, eva osm numhowolalm, ara ten ishovm.
Wo kava wiyera av, osva undva almba yunalmba nomini prov, ara ten ishovm. Wo noinda osva nomba temba kava ishovpa, ara kamba wuhhov, isholmba nomba.
